description: The heads-up display: whether it shows, its cursor and its panels.

enabled.description: Whether the world-scope HUD panels render at all — a world-level kill switch independent of any individual panel's row (a diegetic reveal gate can flip this without editing every panel).

cursor.description: The drawn pointer cursor's presentation policy, or null for no drawn cursor at all — the engine draws no cursor of its own; a world AUTHORS the policy or inherits its basis's. Whole-row replace semantics apply: a SetHudDefaults authored without it clears any earlier authored policy back to hidden.

hoverRadius.description: The cursor ray's hover reach in world units — how far into the world a pointer resolves a hovered row.

sizePx.description: The drawn cursor's ring radius, pixels.

role.description: The bare cursor's core color role; hover lights the accent tier regardless, so Accent here makes the bare cursor and its hover indistinguishable.
role.title: WorldThemeRole

x-enumDescriptions.SurfaceBase: The deepest surface (a held control's seated plate).
x-enumDescriptions.SurfaceRaised: A raised surface (a control's resting plate).
x-enumDescriptions.SurfaceInset: A recessed surface (a well inside a panel).
x-enumDescriptions.Accent: The accent (also the hover and selected tier).
x-enumDescriptions.AccentInk: The ink drawn on the accent.

visible.description: The drawn cursor's visibility condition, or null for always.

cursor.title: WorldHudCursor

visible.description: The visibility condition every world-scope panel is gated by, beside its own, or null for always.

panels.description: Gets the authored world-scope panels. The absence-coalesce lives in the accessor for the same reason Elements's does.

items.description: One HUD panel row — a stable id (unique within the section), a normalized viewport rect in screen space, which band it draws in, its chrome style, and its child elements. WorldMutation.UpsertHudPanel carries the whole row (elements included) as one cross-row transaction boundary; WorldMutation.UpsertHudElement/ WorldMutation.RemoveHudElement read-modify-write a single element within an already-declared panel.

id.description: The panel's stable id (unique within the section — the world.row.set hud.panels/world.row.remove hud.panels mutation address).

rect.description: The panel's viewport rect, normalized to screen space.

layer.description: Which band the panel draws in.

visible.description: The panel's visibility condition over presentation facts, or null for always.

elements.description: Gets the panel's child elements. Absent and empty read identically to every consumer, and the coalesce lives in the accessor so no caller grows its own; every other list-valued row member that reads absent as empty cites this one.

items.title: WorldHudPanel

title: WorldHudSection
